description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {U}, targeting Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 four additional times.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
